idea-plugin.name: Database Analytics Studio
idea-plugin.description:
🗄️ Database Analytics Studio & Query Console

Interactive multi-dialect SQL studio, schema explorer, and query execution engine for Jörmungandr.

  • Multi-Dialect Support: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, DuckDB, and Snowflake
  • Schema Introspection: Catalogs, schemas, tables, columns, primary keys, and data types
  • Query History: Full execution logging with recall to editor, duration tracking, and status
  • DDL Generator: Dialect-aware CREATE TABLE, DROP TABLE, SELECT, and parameterized INSERT templates
  • Instant Export: Copy query results as CSV, JSON, Markdown, or SQL DDL + Inserts
